item.dc:creator: Sidharth Chaudhary
item.description:
I’m excited to share a new Python tool I’ve developed, SignalGenerator. This script is specifically designed with embedded systems in mind, providing a simple yet powerful way to generate and test audio waveforms. While it works on any system with PyAudio, its real value shines when used with hardware like the Raspberry Pi 4’s onboard digital-to-analog converter […]
